Preserve the complete body, full shoes, pose, skin, hair, black formal suit, white collar and tie, proportions, lighting, and right-facing three-quarter side orientation from image 1. Correct ONLY the visibly inaccurate armored robot mask in image 1 to match the canonical Death Stranding DS1 mask shown in image 2. It must be a dark charcoal carbon-fiber human SKULL mask: smooth rounded skull brow, large natural oval eye sockets exposing real eyes, recognizable skull nasal opening, anatomically skull-shaped cheekbones, sculpted teeth across the upper and lower jaw, a compact round brass fastener near the lower cheek and authentic small white LUDENS forehead marking. Use image 2 as exact mask reference; do not copy its composition or background. No angular sci-fi armor plates, no slit visor, no gold forehead emblem, no gas-mask grille. One person, one full-body pose, portrait sprite. This gesture is an original fan-game animation, not a claim of an official animation.
